about.title: We’re Not Consultants. We’re the Ones Who Show Up After the Consultants Leave.
about.body: Every technology leader has a drawer full of strategy decks nobody executed. TechChoice isn’t here to add to that pile. We’re an independent, vendor-agnostic technology advisory firm, and we exist because most of this industry is engineered to point fingers, sell you something, and disappear the moment the contract’s signed. We don’t do that. We assess your business honestly, build YOUR plan, onboard the technologies that optimize your environment, and drive all parties to completion.
about.strong: Boston-born, independently owned, in business since 2014, and allergic to excuses.

process.label: 02 / How we work
process.title: Design. Deliver. Control.

slides.title: Design
slides.text: We evaluate your conditions, build an outcome based on your strategy, and determine the best path forward. This is where the thinking happens.

slides.title: Deliver
slides.text: Decisions were made. Now someone has to make it real. We run the implementation, manage every vendor, and hold everyone to the timeline.

slides.title: Control
slides.text: Go-live is not the finish line. We keep auditing, keep optimizing, and keep your environment from drifting back into the mess we just fixed.

process.foot: One continuous process. Zero handoff gaps.
